name: Joomla

questions.label: Web port
questions.hint: The port on this server that opens the app.

questions.label: Joomla db password
questions.hint: Generated automatically. Enter your own to replace it.

compose:
services:
  app:
    image: joomla:6.2.0-apache
    environment:
      JOOMLA_DB_HOST: joomladb
      JOOMLA_DB_PASSWORD: ${SECRET_JOOMLA_DB_PASSWORD}
    depends_on:
      - joomladb
    ports:
      - target: 80
        published: "${APP_PORT}"
        protocol: tcp
    volumes:
      - type: bind
        source: ${APP_DATA_DIR}/www
        target: /var/www/html
  joomladb:
    image: mysql:9.7.2
    restart: unless-stopped
    environment:
      MYSQL_ROOT_PASSWORD: ${SECRET_JOOMLA_DB_PASSWORD}
    volumes:
      - type: bind
        source: ${APP_DATA_DIR}/mysql
        target: /var/lib/mysql
